name: Anapa-Taman Gas Pipeline

values.RouteNotes: No published GIS or map trace found. Runs in a shared technological corridor with the second string under construction (km 16.7-104.1); candidate could be traced from the existing line by human routes-repo PR.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW, add-threshold met for an operating line GEM never captured (window clause). Re-checked match-to-existing 20260930 snapshot/roster: no row; P2425 Pochinki-Anapa and P2426 Pisarevka-Anapa end at Anapa (Southern Corridor feeders), P0760/P0765/P1368 are Anapa-origin export lines; none is the 106 km Anapa-Taman line. Existence/status: Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar release 17 Feb 2025 (Wayback capture, origin gazprom site unreachable from this host; capture verified) calls it the 'действующий газопровод Анапа - Тамань' / 'уже существующая ветка', operated by Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar (Anapa LPUMG), second string being laid km 0-104; independent of the 2023 Glavgosekspertiza coverage. Length 106 km and in service 2016: bloknotanapa 2023-06 and eprussia 2023-05-29 ('Магистральный газопровод «Анапа – Тамань» протяженностью 106 км является частью Южного газотранспортного коридора, он введен в эксплуатацию в 2016 году') -- these two are the same Glavgosekspertiza story reprinted, count as ONE source for length/start year. Neftegaz 2017-01-26 (not cited as ref; does not name the pipeline) gives 106.5 km for the Gazprom-funded stage 1 trunk to Temryuk district approved by Glavgosekspertiza in 2016, consistent with 106 km. Endpoints: Anapa (Russkaya CS area, ties into Pisarevka-Anapa and Pochinki-Anapa) to Taman / Temryuk district (expansion ends at OTEKO industrial park km 104.1 per neftegazpro). Capacity and Diameter left blank: 7.5 bcm/y in sources is the post-expansion project figure, not the existing line's; no diameter found (expansion tie-ins DN500 only). Owner: Gazprom PJSC inferred from operator Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar (100% Gazprom subsidiary) and Gazprom-funded construction; owner entity reuse 'Gazprom PJSC' (entity_lookup). BOUNDARY vs krasnodar-krai-crimea: Anapa-Taman is Gazprom's Russia-side Southern Corridor feeder (Anapa -> Taman, 106 km, Temryuk district supply); the Kuban-Crimea line is Chernomorneftegaz's separate project whose mainland land portion is only ~1.2 km on the Taman peninsula before two ~16 km Kerch Strait strings (neftegaz 216691 and 229527, route Taman-Simferopol-Sevastopol, verified). So no overlap: Kuban-Crimea starts where Anapa-Taman ends. Unresolved: ru.wikipedia says Kuban-Crimea starts on the Southern Corridor between Kazachya and Russkaya CS and gives 137.5 km Krasnodar-Kerch, which conflicts with the 1.2 km figure; flag for route work. Separate expansion row (parallel string km 16.0-104.1, construction) is staged in anapa-taman-expansion shard; this row is the existing line. Tier medium: status solid (Gazprom primary), length/start year rest on one reprinted story, no independent diameter/capacity. Route: none.
